name: v0.8.2
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.8.2 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(sdk): use the cloud restart route by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1901
* feat(metrics): read independent snapshots from registry files by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2102
* feat(agent): allow explicit in-band relay connections by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2103
* feat(snapshots): add opt-in independent file materialization by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2105
* feat(sdk): add opt-in strict host file opens by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2106
* feat(sdk): add bounded patch source staging by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2107
* feat(sdk): add runtime isolation options by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2143
* feat(cli): add --exclude-from to msb image prune by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2160
### Fixes
* fix(sdk): preserve unexpected cloud HTTP failures by @appcypher in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2120
* fix(metrics): lower default flush interval to 1s and retry seqlock checks by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2154
* fix(network): enforce strict hostname policy on udp egress by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2164
* fix(image): isolate authenticated oci caches and enforce cache auth provenance by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2165
* fix(windows): allow private storage on shared NTFS drives by @appcypher in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2163
### Performance
* perf(ci): cut macOS runner slots and redundant Rust compiles by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2151
### Documentation
* docs(readme): update snapshot and command tree examples by @appcypher in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2124
### Dependencies
* fix(deps): update locked rust dependencies and add cargo-deny audit by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2159
### Maintenance
* chore: refresh lockfiles after v0.8.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2148
* chore(release): bump microsandbox to 0.8.2 by @appcypher in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2122


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/compare/v0.8.1...v0.8.2
